# Codrill

> Codrill is an AI mock technical interview tool. You paste a job posting and it generates 5-8 original coding questions tailored to that specific role, then runs a full interview flow: explain your approach before coding, write real code in an editor, answer follow-up questions about the code you actually wrote, and get scored on correctness, communication, and reasoning.

## Key facts

- First session is free, no signup required.
- After the first session, it's $12 per session (one job posting, one new set of questions).
- Supports JavaScript, Python, and Java in a Monaco-based code editor.
- Optional voice mode: speak your approach and follow-up answers instead of typing.
- Optional Google sign-in adds cross-device session history and a profile page grouping past sessions by job title/role.
- Not a static question bank — every question set is freshly generated from the specific job posting provided.

## Pages

- [Home](/): marketing/landing page with product walkthrough and FAQ.
- [Start a session](/start): paste a job posting to begin.
